purpose: Make decision-time reserves available for BOTH regimes on every future fill, replacing historical backfill. Consumed by the capture binary and by regime_pricing.pool_reserve_oracle / .build_curve_oracle.

discriminators._derivation: first 8 bytes of sha256('event:<Name>') / sha256('account:<Name>'); method verified against the real capture: it reproduces pumpfun TradeEvent = bddb7fd34ee661ee and BondingCurve account = 17b7f83760d8ac60

pump_broad._failed_note: leave unset - losing transactions are training signal
pump_broad._why: Anchor events ride in tx meta.log_messages as base64 'Program data:' payloads. Both regimes' reserves are IN the events: pump.fun TradeEvent carries virtual/real reserves; pump-amm BuyEvent/SellEvent carry pool_base_token_reserves/pool_quote_token_reserves. This filter already catches them - nothing to add.

pump_accounts._why: pump.fun BondingCurve accounts are owned by the pump.fun program and DO carry all four reserves in the account struct (disc 17b7f83760d8ac60, then <QQQQ at offset 8 = virtual_token, virtual_sol, real_token, real_sol - verified in xval_accounts.py against event data). pump-amm Pool accounts (disc f19a6d0411b16dbc) are owned by the pump-amm program and DO NOT hold reserves; they are how we discover the two pool vault addresses.
pump_accounts._verified_present: 14,436 pool account records observed in two 2026-08-24 capture parts

pumpswap_pool_vaults._why: pumpswap reserves live in the pool's SPL token vaults (pool_base_token_account / pool_quote_token_account), whose owner is the TOKEN PROGRAM, so an owner filter cannot reach them. They must be subscribed by ADDRESS.
pumpswap_pool_vaults._address_source: decode each Pool account update from pump_accounts: disc f19a6d0411b16dbc, then base_mint(32) quote_mint(32) lp_mint(32) base_vault(32) quote_vault(32); refresh this account_include list (send an updated SubscribeRequest on the live stream) every 30 s
pumpswap_pool_vaults._validation_rule: at ingest, a vault update is accepted only if the vault's SPL token account mint (bytes 0..32 of the account data) equals the pool's base_mint/quote_mint; otherwise it is dropped and counted, never guessed.

accounts_for_curve_events_only._why: OPTIONAL, belt-and-braces: if event decoding ever lags, the BondingCurve account stream alone reproduces curve reserves, since the account is the post-state of the same transaction.

pool_reserves._consumer: regime_pricing.pool_reserve_oracle -> Regime.AMM (this is the only thing standing between us and the first forward AMM fill)
pool_reserves._both_sources: write a row from the BuyEvent/SellEvent reserves AND from the vault-account update; the two must agree (assert |event - vault| / vault <= 1e-6) or the row is flagged source='disagree' and never used

engine_side_expectations.note: the engine refuses a join whose reserve is older than max_reserve_stale_ms or stamped after its decision; the capture must therefore flush the reserve parquet continuously (not at session end) so the forward trader reads a state that is seconds, not hours, old.

what_is_missing_today: normalizer.rs initialises virtual_sol/virtual_token/real_sol/real_token/curve_complete/mayhem and pool_account_b58/base_reserve/quote_reserve/lp_supply and then NEVER assigns them - it only decodes instruction data, never the Anchor events or account bodies.
no curve/pool reserve parquet is written: the reserves used so far were reconstructed offline from raw ndjson by build_reserves.py / build_slinky_reserves.py.
the account filter covers only the two program owners, so SPL token vaults (pumpswap reserves) are never streamed.
